about: Baselines for npm run ratchet (tools/ratchet.ts). No count may rise; when one falls, lower it here in the same PR (npm run ratchet -- --update). P1-09e (its Decision 15, agreed) renamed every src/ file .ts: tsNocheck raised once to 142, the files strict TypeScript reported (each with its reason in its first line; P1-10 and P1-16 take them out, so it only falls); sourceJavascriptFiles fell from 160 to 2 (public/kc-config.js and public/kc-staging-footer.js, classic scripts copied as they are, still counted so that no other joins them); eslintWarnings set to 347: what ESLint's recommended rules and typescript-eslint's strict set find in src/, as warnings (eslint.config.js), so they only fall. tsNocheck lowered to 128 on 2026-10-21 (P1-10a3): 14 files of the engine's side pass strict TypeScript with annotations alone (P1-10, Decision 7). knownArchitectureViolations set to 169 and unusedCode to 29 on 2026-10-21 (P1-13a, plan P1-13 Decisions 4 and 13): the import rules' known violations (.dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json: the engine's 15 imports of src/views/ and src/db/'s 14 imports outside it, which P1-12 and P1-17 take out, and the 140 findings of the eight import cycles, P1-13e's) and what knip finds unused (15 exports, the dead code P1-23 removes, and 14 exported types of src/schemas/ nothing reads yet), so both only fall. eslintWarnings (346) became eslintSuppressions, set to 809 on 2026-10-21 (P1-13b, plan P1-13 Decisions 4, 5 and 13): every lint rule is an error, and what the rules find is held in ESLint's bulk suppressions (eslint-suppressions.json), counted here from the file: the site's tier's 346 warnings made errors, and what typescript-eslint's type-aware sets find where they came in (318 in the 43 files of src/ that TypeScript checks; 145 of the stylistic set in tests/, tools/ and the configs), so it only falls. A file freed from the type check's switch-off may raise it by its own typed findings, listed in its PR (Decision 5). eslintSuppressions raised to 830 on 2026-10-21 (P1-13c, plan P1-13 Decisions 7 and 8, the one rise its row names): the 21 finds of the rules that came in with it, all for P1-17's access layer: the 17 reads of every column of games, game_players and turn_logs (kc/big-tables-and-profiles-are-read-by-named-columns) and the 4 pages' createClient calls on supabase outside src/db/ (no-restricted-globals). javascriptFiles lowered to 141 (P1-13c): tests/sort-comparators.test.js and tests/profiles-columns.test.js retired, replaced by ESLint rules. javascriptFiles lowered to 140 (P1-13d): tests/html-lint.test.js retired, replaced by kc/html-is-built-only-through-kc-html;
